name: CF-00 System – Error Handler & Data Retention

parameters.content:
## CF-00 · System — Error Handler & Data Retention
**Error branch:** every CompanyFlow workflow points its *Settings → Error workflow* here. A failure is summarised **without input data** (no résumés, passwords or tokens), written to the tamper-evident `audit_log`, and e-mailed to the team.

**Retention branch:** every Sunday 03:00 Cairo: delete chat memory older than 90 days and anonymise candidates whose applications closed more than 12 months ago (data minimisation, Egypt PDPL 151/2020).

Setup: Postgres credential · Gmail credential (or disable the e-mail node) · change the alert address.
